name: Pilao
subtitle: Pilao is a Comorian spiced rice dish; one Comorian recipe cooks rice with chicken, saffron, curry, cardamom, coriander and cinnamon until the rice absorbs all the liquid.

facts.label: What it is
facts.value: Pilao is a spiced rice dish

facts.label: Ceremonies
facts.value: Even at a modest ceremony (mdvoihiricho), pilao remains indispensable, served with mkatra boin'tam (rice bread), madaba (cassava leaves) and grilled meats called djocho

facts.label: Weddings
facts.value: At weddings in wealthier families, emblematic dishes such as pilao, madaba and Comorian-style lobster are joined by luxury or exotic foods

facts.label: Major occasions
facts.value: Pilaou is among the dishes a person from a traditional Comorian family grows up expecting at major occasions

facts.label: Ingredients (one recipe)
facts.value: A Comorian recipe uses chicken, rice and saffron with curry, cardamom, coriander and cinnamon

facts.label: How it is cooked
facts.value: The rice cooks in the sauce over low heat for about half an hour until it absorbs all the water

parts.text: Pilao is a Comorian spiced rice dish; one Comorian recipe cooks rice with chicken, saffron, curry, cardamom, coriander and cinnamon until the rice absorbs all the liquid. It is one of the emblematic dishes of Comorian ceremonies.
Pilao is indispensable at major occasions, even at modest ceremonies, where it is served with rice bread, madaba and grilled meats, and it features among the emblematic dishes at weddings.

blocks.title: Recette du poulet au pilao
blocks.sub: One version of the dish, as given by Afrik.com; the steps are summarised in our own words. Recipes differ from cook to cook.
blocks.note: Spice quantities are not given by the source; prep 20 minutes, cooking 50 minutes. Saffron is listed but its use is not stated in the steps.

steps.text: Cut the chicken into small pieces, toss with half the spices and the finely chopped garlic, brown it in oil in a large pan and set aside.
In a casserole, soften the finely chopped onions, add the diced tomatoes and simmer gently.
Stir in the rice with the rest of the spices so every grain is coated in sauce.
Return the chicken, stir and cook on low heat.
Pour the hot water over the rice, cover and cook gently until the rice has absorbed all the liquid.
